notes: All the vessels of gold and of silver: no construct chain, so the single the is a supplied determiner on the absolute כֵּלִים (rule 15) and the assimilated articles on gold and silver are unrepresented (rule 12); a fronted-article reading was considered and set aside since rule 29's fronting governs a construct rectum.
עִם before the infinitive recast as a temporal clause takes when (rule 52); הַכֹּל → All these gives these to the article (rule 41).
